description: Use this when a request failed with an HTTP status code and you need to know what it means, what to change, and whether retrying is safe. Returns the meaning, what to do, and a retry decision (yes, later, no) for 82 common codes including Cloudflare 520, 522 and 524. Read only.

code.description: The HTTP status code, for example 429 or 503.
